fields.Name: IT121 - View Properties over GraphQL
fields.Description: Client-transport bundle. User View properties over the GraphQL wire: a view run by ViewID with a property value returns only the matching rows; a client value for a property that does not allow override is refused with an error naming it; with no value the server works out a Context.UserID token default for the wire identity; row-level security still applies on top (the seeded scoped user it-rls-a, through its own API key, gets only its own rows); and the server result cache keys on the property values. Self-cleaning fixture: four MJ: AI Agent Runs rows and two shared views, created and deleted over the wire. Needs MJAPI and the seeded RLS users.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Each property value returns its own rows, a locked property refuses a client value by name, a token default applies with no value, and RLS narrows every run.
